items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I saw Bill a few months ago in New York at a benefit at the Central Plaza for Jack Crystal.

ctx.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Bill Price now lives in Minneapolis, but frequently comes to Chicago and he hears about a jam session where he might sit in. So he comes down sometimes for a Sunday session where there is advertised there will be ten bands. Well, he knows that if he comes down there enough people know him that he'd get in one of those bands. So he's on and on for a set or two. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. And I understand that he works occasionally in Minneapolis, becoming a friend of Doc Evans and other...

G-E-R-O-U-L-D. I saw Bill a few months ago in New York at a benefit at the Central Plaza for Jack Crystal. In fact, I saw just about everybody in the world there. It's one of those things everybody turned up.
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Did he go to New York for that or happened to be in New York?
